description: If spawn_or_connect times out waiting for a cold daemon, it can leave a live child behind and let later invocations spawn a second daemon that races socket ownership. Timed-out child daemons must be reaped or terminated before the spawn lock is released.

notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change de8865016485. Timed-out daemon spawns are now explicitly cleaned up before the spawn lock is released, preventing orphan children from racing later cold starts for the public socket. Verification: cargo test -p raql-daemon && cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.
